name: Haphazard Wood Pile AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was

stealth.note: (trained) to notice how the pile might fall on a person disabling it; DC 0 to see the pile.

description: Beams of heavy and sharp wood rest against one another to form a precariously balanced cage tied to several trip lines and tension-bearing dowels.
disable: DC 17 Thievery (trained), Crafting (trained), or Engineering Lore|dc:17 (trained) to figure out how to safely dismantle the pile without it collapsing on anyone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse Inward
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Any of the four revelers within the hazard perform any action with the Move trait

Effect The pile collapses onto the four revelers, dealing (1d6+5) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw save) to each of them. All four also take 1d6 Persistent,bludgeoning Damage damage until they're pulled from the rubble with a Basic DC 17 Athletics check or can Escape dc=17.

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse Outward
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An attempt to disable the hazard from outside critically fails, or the hazard is intentionally triggered by someone from outside of the wood pile

Effect The pile collapses outward, inflicting (1d6+5) Bludgeoning Damage damage to the four revelers (Basic DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw save), and (2d6+5) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw save) to all creatures in a 10-foot area surrounding the central 10-foot-square where the revelers were trapped.
